rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for richly decorated things and elaborate or florid styles, including writing.

example.english: This piece is written in an ornate style; the wording is elaborate but powerful.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章寫得好華麗，字句雖然繁複，但讀落好有氣勢。

rows.note: Use this for a fussy, intricate, or showy design, especially when the decoration feels excessive or gimmicky.

example.english: The design of this cake box is too ornate; it takes ages just to figure out how to open it.
example.traditional: 呢個蛋糕盒個設計太花巧，拆開都要研究半日。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 hap6 go3 cit3 gai3 taai3 faa1 haau2 caak3 hoi1 dou1 jiu3 jin4 gau3 bun3 jat6

rows.note: Use this when the ornate style is deliberately over-the-top or ostentatious rather than merely richly finished.

example.english: The wedding stage was so ornate and over-the-top that the whole hotel looked like an awards ceremony.
example.traditional: 佢個婚禮舞台整到咁浮誇，成間酒店都似開緊頒獎禮。
